model: Each marker render rebuilt a token for every displayed restaurant even when the lists and cluster mode were unchanged. Those tokens are reused. Bounds still go into the later signature. Extra bubble or expanded-cluster ids copy the cached list before appending.

noise.rule: n is the displayed restaurant count. 200 is an example, not a live Seoul sample. A changed list, cluster array, or selection still rebuilds. Not a sampled profiler trace.
